widget.starter:
import numpy as np
from autograd import Tensor, cross_entropy
from cnn_ops_l3 import load_split, init_cnn, cnn_logits, accuracy
from nt_ops_l1 import adam_step, minibatch_indices

EPOCHS = 10
LR = 0.01

X_tr, y_tr, X_va, y_va, X_te, y_te = load_split()
params = init_cnn(8, seed=0)
m = [np.zeros_like(p) for p in params]
v = [np.zeros_like(p) for p in params]
t = 0
for epoch in range(EPOCHS):
    total = 0.0
    for idx in minibatch_indices(len(X_tr), 32, epoch):
        ts = [Tensor(p) for p in params]
        loss = cross_entropy(cnn_logits(ts, X_tr[idx]), y_tr[idx])
        loss.backward()
        t += 1
        params, m, v = adam_step(params, [p.grad for p in ts], m, v, t, LR)
        total += loss.item() * len(idx)
    val = accuracy(cnn_logits, params, X_va, y_va)
    report(epoch, total / len(X_tr), val=val)
print('validation accuracy', round(val, 3))

import numpy as np
from autograd import Tensor, cross_entropy
from cnn_ops_l3 import load_split, init_cnn, cnn_logits, accuracy
from nt_ops_l1 import adam_step, minibatch_indices

X_tr, y_tr, X_va, y_va, _, _ = load_split()


def train_cnn(X_tr, y_tr, X_va, y_va, epochs, lr, seed):
    params = init_cnn(8, seed)
    m = [np.zeros_like(p) for p in params]
    v = [np.zeros_like(p) for p in params]
    t, curve = 0, []
    for epoch in range(epochs):
        for idx in minibatch_indices(len(X_tr), 32, seed + epoch):
            ts = [Tensor(p) for p in params]
            loss = cross_entropy(cnn_logits(ts, X_tr[idx]), y_tr[idx])
            loss.backward()
            t += 1
            params, m, v = adam_step(params, [p.grad for p in ts], m, v, t, lr)
        curve.append(accuracy(cnn_logits, params, X_va, y_va))
    return params, curve

import numpy as np
from autograd import Tensor, cross_entropy
from cnn_ops_l3 import load_split, init_cnn, cnn_logits, accuracy
from nt_ops_l1 import adam_step, minibatch_indices

X_tr, y_tr, X_va, y_va, X_te, y_te = load_split()


def train_cnn(X_tr, y_tr, X_va, y_va, epochs, lr, seed):
    params = init_cnn(8, seed)
    m = [np.zeros_like(p) for p in params]
    v = [np.zeros_like(p) for p in params]
    t, curve = 0, []
    ts = [Tensor(p) for p in params]
    for epoch in range(epochs):
        for idx in minibatch_indices(len(X_tr), 32, seed + epoch):
            for q, p in zip(ts, params):
                q.data = p
            loss = cross_entropy(cnn_logits(ts, X_tr[idx]), y_tr[idx])
            loss.backward()
            t += 1
            params, m, v = adam_step(params, [p.grad for p in ts], m, v, t, lr)
        curve.append(accuracy(cnn_logits, params, X_va, y_va))
    return params, curve
mutants.symptom: The same Tensors are reused and their gradients are never zeroed, so each step adds the old gradients to the new.

import numpy as np
from autograd import Tensor, cross_entropy
from cnn_ops_l3 import load_split, init_cnn, cnn_logits, accuracy
from nt_ops_l1 import adam_step, minibatch_indices

X_tr, y_tr, X_va, y_va, X_te, y_te = load_split()


def train_cnn(X_tr, y_tr, X_va, y_va, epochs, lr, seed):
    params = init_cnn(8, seed)
    m = [np.zeros_like(p) for p in params]
    v = [np.zeros_like(p) for p in params]
    t, curve = 0, []
    best, keep = -1.0, None
    for epoch in range(epochs):
        for idx in minibatch_indices(len(X_tr), 32, seed + epoch):
            ts = [Tensor(p) for p in params]
            loss = cross_entropy(cnn_logits(ts, X_tr[idx]), y_tr[idx])
            loss.backward()
            t += 1
            params, m, v = adam_step(params, [p.grad for p in ts], m, v, t, lr)
        curve.append(accuracy(cnn_logits, params, X_va, y_va))
        te = accuracy(cnn_logits, params, X_te, y_te)
        if te > best:
            best, keep = te, params
    return keep, curve
mutants.symptom: It keeps the epoch with the best test accuracy: early stopping on the test split, so the test score is no longer held out.
